name: White Bean Soup with Basil, Rosemary, and Garlic Croutons
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: 2 cans (2 lbs) white beans, such as cannellini, drained
1 cup of your favorite marinara pasta sauce
¼ cup packed fresh basil leaves, or 1 tsp dried basil leaves

steps: Purée ingredients in a blender until smooth.
Pour into a large saucepan or Dutch Oven, and bring to a simmer.
Simmer, partially covered and stirring frequently, to blend flavors, 4–5 minutes.

culture.text: A crouton is a piece of toasted or fried bread, normally cubed and seasoned. Croutons are used to add texture and flavor to salads—notably the Caesar salad—as an accompaniment to soups and stews, or eaten as a snack food.
